name: DDE standard SDTM methods
description: Shared SDTM derivation methods, MSG v2 style: one method per algorithm with generic -- text and no domain in the OID. Each method carries a draft ODM v2.0 MethodSignature; none carries a FormalExpression yet. 'basis' states where the wording comes from; entries marked Draft are new text to be checked against the SDTMIG CDISC Notes. See data/methods/README.md.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive USUBJID
methods.description: Concatenation of STUDYID, SITEID and SUBJID.

parameters.name: STUDYID
parameters.description: Study identifier

parameters.name: SITEID
parameters.description: Study site identifier

parameters.name: SUBJID
parameters.description: Subject identifier within the study

returnValues.name: USUBJID
returnValues.description: Unique subject identifier across all studies

methods.basis: Draft: sponsor convention to confirm (methods plan open item 1). Matches the defaults dictionary's USUBJID length basis. CDISC01 MT.USUBJID concatenates STUDYID and SUBJID; SDTM-MSG v2.0 section 5.2.1 says the concatenation is not required.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive --SEQ
methods.description: Unique sequence number within a subject, restarting at 1 for every subject, applied to sorted data.

parameters.name: USUBJID
parameters.description: Subject the record belongs to; records are sorted by the dataset's key variables

returnValues.name: SEQ
returnValues.description: Sequence number of the record within the subject

methods.name: Algorithm to derive TSSEQ
methods.description: Unique sequence number within each TSPARM, restarting at 1 for each TSPARM, applied to sorted data.

parameters.name: TSPARMCD
parameters.description: Trial summary parameter short name

returnValues.name: TSSEQ
returnValues.description: Sequence number of the record within the parameter

methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.TSSEQ, with 'for per TSPARM' corrected to 'for each TSPARM'.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive --DY
methods.description: Study day relative to RFSTDTC. Date - RFSTDTC + 1 if on or after RFSTDTC. Date - RFSTDTC if date precedes RFSTDTC.

parameters.name: DTC
parameters.description: Date of the observation (--DTC, --STDTC or --ENDTC)

parameters.name: RFSTDTC
parameters.description: Subject reference start date from DM

methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.DAYCALC, verbatim; SDTMIG 3.4 section 4.4.4.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive --STRESC
methods.description: --STRESC is equal to --ORRES, or to the value in standard units when a conversion is necessary. "--" represents the domain code.

parameters.name: ORRES
parameters.description: Result or finding in original units

parameters.name: ORRESU
parameters.description: Original units

parameters.name: STRESU
parameters.description: Standard units

returnValues.name: STRESC
returnValues.description: Result or finding in standard format

methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.LBSTRESC, generalized to -- the way MSG generalized MT.STRESN.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive --STRESN
methods.description: If --STRESC represents a numeric value then --STRESN is the numeric version of --STRESC, else null. "--" represents the domain code.

parameters.name: STRESC
parameters.description: Result or finding in standard format

returnValues.name: STRESN
returnValues.description: Numeric result or finding in standard units

methods.name: Algorithm to derive --LOBXFL
methods.description: Set to "Y" for last record with non-null original result on or before the first dose date (RFXSTDTC). Null otherwise.

parameters.name: ORRES
parameters.description: Result or finding in original units

parameters.name: DTC
parameters.description: Date of the observation

parameters.name: RFXSTDTC
parameters.description: Date of first study treatment from DM

methods.name: Algorithm to derive EPOCH
methods.description: EPOCH from SE where date >= SESTDTC and date < SEENDTC

parameters.name: DTC
parameters.description: Date of the observation

parameters.name: SESTDTC
parameters.description: Start of the subject's Element from SE

parameters.name: SEENDTC
parameters.description: End of the subject's Element from SE

returnValues.name: EPOCH
returnValues.description: Epoch of the SE record whose interval contains the date

methods.name: Algorithm to derive SESTDTC
methods.description: SESTDTC is set to the --DTC for that subject which exists in the data for the defined start of the Element, such as DSSTDTC when DSDECOD=INFORMED CONSENT OBTAINED for Screening Elements or min(EXSTDTC) for Dosing Elements.

parameters.name: DTC
parameters.description: The --DTC that marks the defined start of the Element

methods.basis: SDTM-MSG v2.0 define.xml MT.SESTDTC, with 'SESTDTC if set to' corrected to 'SESTDTC is set to'.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive SEENDTC
methods.description: SEENDTC is set to the start of the next Element, or RFPENDTC for the last Element.

parameters.name: NEXTSESTDTC
parameters.description: SESTDTC of the subject's next Element

parameters.name: RFPENDTC
parameters.description: End of participation from DM

methods.name: Algorithm to derive SVSTDTC
methods.description: For each scheduled visit, SVSTDTC = the first (min) date associated with a subject for that visit. For unplanned visits, SVSTDTC is the date of the visit.

parameters.name: VISITNUM
parameters.description: Visit number

parameters.name: DTC
parameters.description: Dates the subject's records carry for the visit

methods.name: Algorithm to derive SVENDTC
methods.description: For each scheduled visit, SVENDTC = the last (max) date associated with a subject for that visit. For unplanned visits, SVENDTC is the date of the visit.

parameters.name: VISITNUM
parameters.description: Visit number

parameters.name: DTC
parameters.description: Dates the subject's records carry for the visit

methods.name: Algorithm to derive RFSTDTC
methods.description: The first date/time of study drug. Null for screen failures.

parameters.name: EXSTDTC
parameters.description: Start dates of study drug exposure

parameters.name: ARMNRS
parameters.description: Reason arm is null; identifies screen failures

methods.name: Algorithm to derive RFENDTC
methods.description: The Date of Study Completion or Early Termination. Null for screen failures.

parameters.name: DSSTDTC
parameters.description: Disposition date of study completion or early termination

parameters.name: ARMNRS
parameters.description: Reason arm is null; identifies screen failures

methods.name: Algorithm to derive RFXSTDTC
methods.description: The first date/time of study drug administration. Null for subjects with no treatment data.

parameters.name: EXSTDTC
parameters.description: Start dates of study drug administration

methods.name: Algorithm to derive RFXENDTC
methods.description: The last date/time of study drug administration. Null for subjects with no treatment data.

parameters.name: EXENDTC
parameters.description: End dates of study drug administration

methods.name: Algorithm to derive RFPENDTC
methods.description: The latest date of assessment for the subject as determined by the End of Study Form, any scheduled assessments, Adverse Events, or Concomitant Medications.

parameters.name: EOSDTC
parameters.description: Date recorded on the End of Study form

parameters.name: ASSESSDTC
parameters.description: Dates of the subject's scheduled assessments

parameters.name: AEDTC
parameters.description: Dates of the subject's adverse events

parameters.name: CMDTC
parameters.description: Dates of the subject's concomitant medications

methods.name: Algorithm to derive RFICDTC
methods.description: Date/time of informed consent, from DSSTDTC where DSDECOD = INFORMED CONSENT OBTAINED.

parameters.name: DSSTDTC
parameters.description: Start date/time of the disposition event

parameters.name: DSDECOD
parameters.description: Standardized disposition term

methods.basis: Draft: SDTMIG DM notes for RFICDTC.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive AGE
methods.description: Age in AGEU at RFSTDTC: complete years from BRTHDTC to RFSTDTC.

parameters.name: BRTHDTC
parameters.description: Date of birth

parameters.name: RFSTDTC
parameters.description: Subject reference start date/time

methods.basis: Draft: CDISC01 MT.AGE and the SDTMIG DM notes for AGE.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive DTHFL
methods.description: If DTHDTC is populated then DTHFL='Y'

parameters.name: DTHDTC
parameters.description: Date/time of death

methods.name: Algorithm to derive BMI
methods.description: BMI = Weight (kg) / Height (m)^2. Not calculated if missing or invalid.

parameters.name: WEIGHT
parameters.description: Weight in kg

parameters.name: HEIGHT
parameters.description: Height in m

methods.basis: CRF Specialization BMI row (data/crf_specializations/cdisc_crf_specializations_draft.csv), derivation_description verbatim.

methods.name: Algorithm to derive --DTC
methods.description: --DTC is the ISO 8601 combination of the collected date and time components. Components not collected are omitted (partial date/time).

parameters.name: DAT
parameters.description: Collected date (CDASH --DAT)

parameters.name: TIM
parameters.description: Collected time (CDASH --TIM)

returnValues.name: DTC
returnValues.description: ISO 8601 date/time; partialDatetime once PR-DDS-3 adds it

methods.basis: Draft: CDASHIG mapping instructions for --DAT/--TIM and the SDTMIG ISO 8601 rules. Attaches only where another source already made a --DTC Derived.

assignments.name: TSSEQ
assignments.description: TSSEQ restarts per TSPARM, not per subject.

assignments.name: --DY
assignments.description: Covers --DY, --STDY and --ENDY. VISITDY is Protocol, so it never reaches here.

assignments.name: VSORRES
assignments.description: Value level: the VSORRES item whose where clause admits VSTESTCD = BMI.

assignments.name: --DTC
assignments.description: Exact entries (RFSTDTC, SESTDTC, SVSTDTC, ...) outrank this suffix.
